name: pwr_currentconsumption_standby_rtc
description: PWR_CurrentConsumption in Standby mode with the RTC (STANDBY_RTC_MODE, the readme's fifth line). After B1 (held from 0.5 to 1.2 s) the RTC is set up on LSI with its wake-up timer, WUF and WUTF cleared, and the part enters Standby: the pins let go, LD2 goes dark, PWR_CSR reads 0. The RTC counts on through Standby; 0xA000 periods of LSI/16 later (20.48 s at the 32 kHz LSI) its wake-up event sets WUF and ends Standby: the part resets as at power-on but for the backup domain (RCC_CSR's PORRSTF, PINRSTF and BORRSTF), main finds SBF set, clears it and toggles LD2 every 100 ms; PWR_CSR keeps WUF (0x34001 with the regulator's ready bits).
